title: Brainstorm: model-extracted campaign bible (06b-B)
description: Explore design for loreweaver-5ze. Decide: combine bible extraction with the arc-summary model call or run as two separate calls; JSON parsing/validation strategy; error-handling interaction with the arc rollup. Reuses 4ua plumbing pattern.
notes:
Decision (Q1): Pipeline — extract bible first, then pass bible into the arc-summary prompt so the summary can reference named NPCs/factions canonically. Implication: composeArcSummary signature grows to accept a CampaignBible input; CLI rollupCampaignArc orchestrates two sequential model calls.
Decision (Q2): Bible failure path = retry once, then atomic-skip (skip both bible and arc summary; prior arc_summary stays). Arc-summary call retains 4ua's single-attempt contract. Combined contract: bible-extract call -> on error, retry once -> on second error, log warning + return early. If bible succeeds and arc-summary subsequently fails, atomic-skip (log warning + return early before rollupArcSummary write).

Decision (Q3 — JSON parsing): follow orchestrator's fenced-block pattern. Dedicated fence tag (e.g. 'bible_json'); parse with a small regex + JSON.parse + shape check (object with worldFacts/majorNpcs/factions/openThreads each string[]); throw typed MemorySummaryError on parse/shape failure.
close_reason: Design approved; epic populated on loreweaver-5ze; 5 child tasks filed under loreweaver-5ze.1-5.
